tee_group_approaches.intended_post_socket_contact: Four Ø6.9 native post sweeps per valve. Only the four post cylinders below the bearing plane are removed from the separate body-distance query. Body material at or aft of the bearing plane is queried against all fixed solids aft of that plane. It is separated from all fore-side stock for positive approach offset and can meet its bearing faces only at the terminal plane. The remaining native port belly below that plane is queried against the complete quadrant.
